{{Quote|How would you feel about joining a very elite little club?|Eramuth Bwua'tu to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''Club Bwuat'u''' was a clandestine organization within the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government and other well-placed and informed [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] who were determined to uncover the various [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracies]] that seemed to be bent on total [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] anarchy. Among the membership were both [[Nek Bwua'tu|Nek]] and [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]], [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]], interim [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Padnel Ovin]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]], and several others. The group also sought to bring [[Qaras]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rokari Kem]] into their fold; however, unbeknownst to them Rokari Kem was actually [[Abeloth]], and while Padnel Ovin was addressing the Senate, Abeloth used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.

Club Bwua'tu played an important part in the planning for the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|Jedi operation to liberate Coruscant]]. Knowing the Jedi would return to reclaim Coruscant, the Sith started seizing different important positions in the administration such as immigration posts, high-ranking positions in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Department of Justice]]. However, Club Bwua'tu started infiltrating teams of two or three Jedi onto Coruscant. They later assisted in the liberation with [[Galactic Alliance Marines]] loyal to Admiral Bwua'tu.
